page.overview:
Who is Taliesin's dragonborn paladin?

Taliesin's dragonborn paladin was the character that Taliesin Jaffe played in the first (and possibly second and third) session(s) of Matthew Mercer's campaign that would eventually become Critical Role. It was during this session that Vox Machina first encountered the Myriad.
